security_problem: SECURITY INVARIANT: a lineage_require tools/call is denied before relay unless R1 registered-principal, R2 delegation-ceiling including exact capability-to-action coverage, and R3 mandatory trajectory-binding all hold under one policy/redaction generation. The policy trajectory binds capability+server+tool+effect; the request must match it; the requested capability and resource must be covered by the leaf and every ancestor. Agent graphs are acyclic and identity/grant validity is [start,expiry), including a post-approval revalidation against the authorizing snapshot with a fresh clock. A root grant may only name a root agent. Approval terminal lineage uses an immutable snapshot-redacted copy from the authorizing generation and is retained on post-approval ownership and delegation denials. Identity-less policy JSON/hash bytes remain exact. No LLM/advisory signal participates. H44 authorizes an operator-bound session identity; it does not authenticate the underlying agent process.
required_behavior: A valid Human->Planner->Coding github.repo.write trajectory allows only write_file/effect=write after durable audit commit. Missing or mismatched capability/trajectory, read-grant/write-action substitution, invalid/future identity or grant, malformed graph, a Human root grant to a registered child agent, and existing R1/R2/R3/parser failures deny or fail startup as specified. After approval, lineage is revalidated with a fresh clock against the same immutable snapshot before commit; a grant that expires during the wait denies. Post-approval ownership and delegation denials retain snapshot-redacted lineage evidence. Removing redaction patterns during approval never exposes lineage in allow or deny terminal events. Legacy identity-less policy JSON and approval policy hash equal the frozen base golden. Real stdio demo preserves observed allow=yes and deny=no while the slice meets the explicit complexity budget.
failure_behavior: Any authorization uncertainty denies with zero relay. Malformed lineage policy prevents startup. A stale pre-wait lineage allow never authorizes after approval. No post-approval path may re-read mutable live policy or mutable redaction patterns for unsanitized lineage. Legacy policies without identity/trajectories omit both JSON fields and never lineage-gate.
non_goals: wildcard or substring capability or resource matching
changes to approval, audit durability, or anomaly-advisor semantics beyond lineage snapshot redaction
README, workflow, release, or review-artifact edits

attack_classes.expected: unknown, default, expired, or not-yet-valid actor denies before relay
missing, expired, future-issued, subject/issuer/ancestor, capability, or resource ceiling failure denies before relay
trajectory binds exact capability+server+tool+effect; missing/mismatched capability or trajectory and read-grant/write-action substitution deny
canonical unique-key arguments are the sole lineage claim source
post-approval allow and deny use an immutable lineage copy redacted before the authorizing runtime generation is released
absent lineage fields do not change frozen base policy JSON or approval policy hash
self-parent and multi-node AgentIdentity cycles fail startup; a Human root grant to a child agent with a declared parent fails registry construction
future-created/future-issued records deny and start>=expiry fails startup; a grant that expires during an approval wait is revalidated against the snapshot and denies before commit
post-approval ownership and delegation denials retain the snapshot-redacted lineage evidence
malformed or unresolved lineage policy fails validation
one canonical lineage fixture, shared demo plumbing, no repeated 50+ line YAML, lineage demo <=260 lines, and total additions <=2450 versus base
